## Outcome and dependencies

Produce a reviewed, versioned protocol for #62 that makes the authorized-PR evaluation reproducible and distinguishes **controlled seam evidence**, **live GitHub delivery**, and **real-provider outcome quality** before evaluation results are observed. Record whether the live stages are ready or blocked; protocol completion is not live-run authorization or a P5 pass.

**Parent:** #62. **Depends on:** no new implementation or cleanup issue. The post-#50 maintenance and #60 / PR #61 alignment are already the starting point. This issue precedes live boundary validation and the quality campaign.

## Authority and inspected baseline

Follow [docs/governing/current.md](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/main/docs/governing/current.md#next-phase-p5-native-workflow-product-evaluation), then #62, then current production code and [tests/README.md](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/main/tests/README.md). The native integration/source/result-handoff documents are supporting context, not alternative plans.

Backlog inspection used `main` at `b901367b339c3ca715fa51ad91646b499a8fa068`. [pyproject.toml](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/b901367b339c3ca715fa51ad91646b499a8fa068/pyproject.toml) pins the release SDK/wheel; [zeroshot_sdk.py](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/b901367b339c3ca715fa51ad91646b499a8fa068/broodling/zeroshot_sdk.py) selects the runtime and distinguishes DirectTarget delivery from the local no-effect profile. Record the actual evaluation baseline rather than silently substituting a newer dependency or provider selection.

## Work and completion criteria

1. **Freeze the claims and measurement rules.** Select a small bounded task set with valid change controls and meaningful failure opportunities (incomplete/wrong-scope changes, missed acceptance behavior, or attempts to reinterpret frozen authority). Define independent judging checks/review against original criteria, expected outcomes, sampling/repetition rules, and readiness criteria before live evaluation. Choose and justify the corpus size and acceptance decision rules prospectively. If quantitative thresholds are used, freeze and justify them here; if the sample cannot support a meaningful quantitative threshold, say so explicitly and define what evidence is required for the P5 gate instead. Do not inherit v0.5 numbers. Judge the exact receipt `headRevision`, not today's PR tip or the mutable execution worktree. Keep evaluator expectations separate from the task inputs, and disclose any supplied validation guidance. Evaluation controls must not become mandatory admission proof plans; include criteria-only admission.
2. **Freeze counting and stopping rules.** Define correct outcomes, false acceptance, unjustified rejection/noncompletion, legitimate refusal, infrastructure failure, capability gap, and indeterminate judgment. Keep native result, Broodling disposition, and independent judgment distinct. Define denominators and treatment of retries, incomplete runs, missing observations, protocol amendments, and exploratory/controlled diagnostics. Retain every started run; no rerun-until-green selection. State how correction effectiveness, churn, cost and latency will be observed where available, without requiring private repair traces. Decide in advance whether a qualifying boundary-validation run can also enter the quality sample; never double-count it.
3. **Record live preflight and explicit operator authorization.** Identify the disposable GitHub repository/target branch, entitled task sources and B1s, compatible configured DirectTarget, target/operator-owned provider installation and sandbox profile, provider authentication, current delivery-credential availability, and agreed per-run/campaign run and spend limits. Record approval references/status, never credentials. The local launcher does not constrain the DirectTarget. No supplied infrastructure or approval may be presumed. Set safe stop and host-teardown arrangements outside Broodling's cleanup authority. Allocate independent trials without replacing or reusing dispatched Attempts; use separate properly admitted Work Units/workspaces where needed and account for their quarantine/resource cost.
4. **Use existing validation and retain a protocol record.** Record the product/dependency/host baseline and `python -m pytest tests` result on the supported profile, or the concrete reason it cannot be obtained. Map required Broodling boundary claims to existing tests; do not recreate native workflow tests. Version the protocol, task/judging material, evidence layout, reproduction commands and preflight decision. Missing SDK coverage cannot count as a successful check.

The protocol can be completed with an explicit **live execution BLOCKED** preflight when infrastructure or approval is unavailable, provided measurement choices are frozen and every blocker is named. Neither that completion nor a proposed budget permits dispatch. The corresponding live issue remains blocked until current prerequisites and authorization are satisfied.

## Evidence to retain

Retain the protocol commit/version and review/freeze decision; task/source/B1 and judging definitions; exact product/dependency/provider/target identities; default-suite commands, results and missing coverage; authorized effect/target and budget approval references; preflight checklist with ready/blocked reasons; and the run-record/counting/reproduction specification. Use a new P5 evidence location; preserve historical qualification bytes and verdicts. Keep records outside disposable execution worktrees and redact secrets without erasing provenance.

## Permitted changes and stop boundary

May add evaluation documentation, task fixtures, independent judging checks and the smallest offline/evaluation-only helper needed to exercise existing Python entrypoints. May run the current controlled default suite. No production behavior, schema, dependency/runtime selection or architecture changes; no live provider campaign or live PR delivery in this issue.

Stop at protocol freeze and preflight disposition. A concrete product blocker gets a retained reproducer and separately justified follow-up, not a generic cleanup phase. Preserve no-effect stable-result refusal and quarantine of every dispatched Attempt. No custom graph/evidence worker/adjudicator/final assessor/supervisor, automatic replacement, broader effects, CLI/service packaging, tuning campaign, or historical G1–G4 rerun. **Planning item only at creation; not started.**

## Completed — protocol frozen; live execution BLOCKED

Committed on `main` as **[`717e94b3548d1dc029bfb54e2758e9929f1d93bd`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/commit/717e94b3548d1dc029bfb54e2758e9929f1d93bd)**. The inspected product baseline remains `b901367b339c3ca715fa51ad91646b499a8fa068`; the new commit adds only six files under `evaluation/p5/v1/`. Git tree identities confirm production, existing tests, dependencies, governing documents and historical qualification are unchanged.

### Frozen material

- [Protocol v1](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/717e94b3548d1dc029bfb54e2758e9929f1d93bd/evaluation/p5/v1/protocol.md): claims, sample/order, outcome definitions, denominators, readiness thresholds, budgets/stops/replay, amendments, evidence layout and reproduction requirements.
- [Corpus and judging definitions](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/717e94b3548d1dc029bfb54e2758e9929f1d93bd/evaluation/p5/v1/corpus.md), [two-file target fixture](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/tree/717e94b3548d1dc029bfb54e2758e9929f1d93bd/evaluation/p5/v1/fixture), and [evaluation-only judge](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/717e94b3548d1dc029bfb54e2758e9929f1d93bd/evaluation/p5/v1/judge.py): reproducible original B1, exact criteria-only inputs, separate evaluator examples/reference controls, exact-receipt-revision checks plus mandatory independent full-criteria/scope review.
- [Preflight and freeze review](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/717e94b3548d1dc029bfb54e2758e9929f1d93bd/evaluation/p5/v1/preflight.md): product/dependency/runtime and observed host baseline, existing claim-to-test map, actual offline validation, nine named live blockers and operator evidence needed to resolve them.

### Measurement choices later work must follow

Eight serial trials: four tasks, two repetitions each. Tasks cover strict parsing, stable deduplication, CSV edge cases and frozen access criteria despite conflicting repository guidance. All use criteria-only admission, original B1 `884bd64264df1515bee76a63f548db9cabe25a35`, one authorized native PR to `p5-eval`, and separate properly entitled Work Units/Attempts/workspaces. Actual disposable repository, issue locators and target are not assigned or presumed.

R01 is #64's boundary trial and is predeclared in the eight-slot accounting regardless of outcome; it counts only once. No provider substitutions or extra boundary runs are allowed in v1. A failed/blocked boundary prevents the remaining quality campaign.

Native result, Broodling disposition and independent judgment are separate facts. Judge the actual retained receipt `headRevision`, never the current PR tip/worktree. Retain all started slots, refusals, failed/ambiguous dispatches, missing observations and unstarted cases. No replacement of dispatched Attempts or rerun-until-green. Prospective amendments get a new version/cohort; old results are preserved, not pooled away.

The positive bounded smoke-readiness threshold is a genuine supported default-suite pass plus live boundary pass, all eight slots resolved, at least 7/8 correct outcomes with at least one per task, zero false acceptances, at most one unjustified noncompletion, no unresolved infrastructure/capability/indeterminate cases, and no authority/budget/quarantine violations. This is not a broad reliability claim or P5 verdict; #66 remains the separate evidence review.

Requested maximum envelope: 8 serial trials/native runs, USD 20/trial and USD 160 total, 30 minutes active native time/trial and 240 total. **Currently approved: zero runs and zero spend.** These are frozen caps, not estimates or approval. Operator accounting/enforcement and stop margins must be established before dispatch. Every dispatched Attempt remains quarantined; operator host teardown is outside Broodling cleanup authority.

### Validation and preflight

Offline evaluator checks passed: reproducible fixture B1/tree/hashes; four defective B1 controls rejected and four positive reference controls accepted; exact-object CLI checks unaffected by a wrong mutable worktree; changed README rejected; B1-as-result refused; Python syntax and whitespace checks. Uploaded file blob hashes match the locally checked bytes. These are evaluation-material controls, not live/provider/SDK evidence.

**`python -m pytest tests`: NOT RUN / BLOCKED.** The session lacks the pinned SDK, Hypothesis, pytest-timeout and a complete mounted repository checkout; local Git network access failed DNS resolution. No missing SDK coverage is called successful. The preflight retains the required supported-host command and evidence requirements.

Live blockers B01–B09 cover the supported-suite result; authorized disposable repository/branch; entitled task/trial allocations; compatible configured DirectTarget/provider; target sandbox/trust policy; provider/delivery credential availability; explicit effect/run/spend approval; named external stop/teardown and quarantine capacity; and independent judging plus durable evidence retention. None was inferred from repository access or earlier hosts.

**Freeze decision:** author-reviewed `p5-native-pr-v1`, reviewable at the immutable commit above, with live preflight BLOCKED. No independent peer approval or operator authorization is claimed. Operator authorization must acknowledge this exact freeze commit; measurement changes require a prospective new version.

#63 is complete under its explicit blocked-preflight completion rule. **#64 is NOT READY for live execution. #64/#65 were not begun; no live provider call, native PR evaluation, task issue creation, target setup or credential probe was performed.** No new cleanup issue or assurance architecture was introduced.

## Prospective protocol refinement — v2 frozen before any live result

The issue wording has been refined to make **whether/how to use quantitative thresholds** an explicit P5 protocol decision rather than assuming one is appropriate:

> Choose and justify the corpus size and acceptance decision rules prospectively. If quantitative thresholds are used, freeze and justify them here; if the sample cannot support a meaningful quantitative threshold, say so explicitly and define what evidence is required for the P5 gate instead.

No live provider/PR evaluation had begun when this refinement was made. The original `p5-native-pr-v1` record at `717e94b3548d1dc029bfb54e2758e9929f1d93bd` remains frozen provenance.

The prospective replacement for future #64/#65 dispatch is **[`p5-native-pr-v2`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/1d581717509de182410c3ab2f54d3f65768d8d7f/evaluation/p5/v2/protocol.md)**, frozen at **[`1d581717509de182410c3ab2f54d3f65768d8d7f`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/commit/1d581717509de182410c3ab2f54d3f65768d8d7f)**.

### What changed

- The eight serial trials, four task families, two repetitions, R01 boundary reuse, exact-revision judging, classifications, denominators, all-started retention, retry/reconciliation rules, budgets, quarantine and evidence requirements are unchanged.
- v2 explicitly says the purposive eight-trial corpus **cannot support a statistically meaningful reliability percentage**. Raw fractions remain descriptive observations only.
- `7/8 CO` is no longer an independent acceptance threshold. The gate is claim-level: supported suite + live boundary; all eight slots accounted for with determinate accepted-revision judgments; every task represented by a correct outcome; zero false acceptance; no unresolved IF/CG/I/LR; and at most one isolated UR only when the paired repetition for that task is CO. A second UR or two non-correct repetitions of one task makes the positive gate impossible.
- #66 still performs skeptical evidence review and may reject readiness even if that minimum evidence pattern is present; the rule is not a disguised reliability estimate.
- The stopping rule now refers to the **claim-level positive gate becoming impossible**, rather than a numeric percentage becoming impossible.

### Status

Live preflight remains **BLOCKED**. Approved runs/spend remain **0 / USD 0**. The existing B01–B09 prerequisites remain unresolved. #64 is still **NOT READY** and must bind operator authorization to the v2 freeze commit before dispatch.

#62, #64, #65 and #66 have been updated to reference and apply v2. No production code, dependency, corpus fixture, evaluator, provider/model selection, budget cap or live infrastructure was changed.

title: [P5] Freeze evaluation protocol and record live-run preflight
